ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Admin login race condition — Login.submit() calls navigate('/admin'), URL briefly becomes /admin (AdminPanel mounts and calls /admin/stats|users|companies) but within ~500ms is REPLACED with /dashboard, causing admin to land on the Dashboard (in user-profile mode, showing VIVACE OFFICIAL) instead of AdminPanel. Reproduced 3/3 times with framenavigated log: `-> /admin`, then `-> /dashboard`. Because AdminPanel unmounts before user can interact, no admin panel functionality (tabs users/companies/support/ads, verify/block/edit/delete, ads create) is reachable via the login flow. nav-admin link from Header (visible only if user.role==='admin' on other pages) may still work as a workaround but was not exercised.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix admin-login redirect regression. Root cause is very likely the <PublicOnly> wrapper around <Login> (App.js line 47-53). After login() sets user, PublicOnly re-renders with user=admin/email_verified=true and returns <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace/>, which fires in the SAME render cycle as navigate('/admin') from Login.submit(), and the /dashboard replace wins after the /admin push. Suggested fix: in PublicOnly, when user.role==='admin' redirect to '/admin', OR in Login.submit() DO NOT call navigate() at all and instead let the router-level PublicOnly handle role-based redirect (add an admin branch). Simplest: `if (user && user.role === 'admin') return <Navigate to='/admin' replace/>;` BEFORE the generic /dashboard fallback in PublicOnly.
MINOR: Add retry-on-503 in put_object() (server.py L74) for transient Emergent object storage flakes.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js PublicOnly does not consider admin role — it always redirects logged-in users to /dashboard, causing the observed regression. Add admin branch: `if (user && user.role === 'admin') return <Navigate to='/admin' replace/>;`

rca_of_the_issue: Admin login (Login.submit): after `await api.post('/auth/login')`, code does `login(token, data.user); ...; if (data.user.role === 'admin') navigate('/admin')`. `login()` calls setUser() (via AuthContext), which triggers a re-render of the still-mounted Login route. Its wrapper <PublicOnly> re-evaluates: `if (user) return <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace/>`. Because PublicOnly does NOT special-case admin, the <Navigate> replaces the URL with /dashboard. Simultaneously navigate('/admin') from the submit handler pushes /admin. The net observed sequence (via framenavigated event) is `/admin -> /dashboard`, i.e. the /dashboard replace/push takes effect AFTER /admin, unmounting AdminPanel. Reproduction: 3/3 fresh sessions with cleared localStorage. Mitigation: In App.js PublicOnly, add `if (user && user.role === 'admin') return <Navigate to='/admin' replace/>;` before the generic `if (user) return <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace/>;`. Alternative: in Login.submit(), skip navigate() and rely purely on PublicOnly with admin branch.
